acceptance: A test shows a PR changing only oracle-verdict.yml is classified as soundness (the required oracle-review check then needs an oracle decision)
Merged through the normal oracle PR flow (the list itself is a soundness path)
context: Found 2026-10-09 while writing the CI and dev-loop batch handoff. .github/oracle-reviewers.yml gate_paths (classifier tier) already lists oracle-verdict.yml; only the soundness list lacks it.
description:
.github/soundness-paths.txt lists the required checker (.github/workflows/oracle-review.yml, _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py), the reviewer package (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/) and the policy (.github/oracle-reviewers.yml), but not .github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml, the workflow that runs the reviewers with their credentials and posts the App review the required check reads. It was not listed under its old name (oracle-review-shadow.yml) either when #2758 made the oracle required. A PR that changes only oracle-verdict.yml therefore needs no oracle review and passes the required check without one, although the change alters every later review.

Add `file .github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml` to .github/soundness-paths.txt and update the tests that pin the list. Adding a path only strengthens the gate.
